summary: @nathan_stevens Worse than that. It is indicative of tech being used to SHOWCASE what was learned rather than using tech to learn or learning tech. Why I push back when people say "elevate" lessons. Forget that. Learning to read and write the web is a lofty goal already.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@nathan_stevens Worse than that. It is indicative of tech being used to SHOWCASE what was learned rather than using tech to learn or learning tech.

Why I push back when people say "elevate" lessons.

Forget that. Learning to read and write the web is a lofty goal already.
